body:
## Purpose

Fixes #59078. In batch-invariant mode, `mean_batch_invariant` returns FP32 for FP16/BF16 inputs when no output dtype is requested. This promotes DeepEncoder's `LayerNorm2d` output to FP32, causing the next BF16 convolution to fail during startup.

Restore the input dtype at the final return while retaining FP32 accumulation and the existing reduction order. Explicit FP32 requests remain FP32. Extend the existing determinism suite with default/explicit output dtype coverage across FP16/BF16/FP32 and single/multiple reduction dimensions.

Duplicate-work check (2026-09-28): reviewed #59078 and its comments and searched open PRs for `59078 in:body` and `mean_batch_invariant`. No competing fix or ownership claim was found. Related #55249 fixes softmax and #55466 fixes matmul precision; neither addresses this mean output dtype.

AI assistance: Codex assisted with implementation, tests, review, and local validation.

## Test Plan

Commands below use `.venv/bin/python` to denote the existing Python 3.12 virtualenv shared with the isolated worktree:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py -k test_mean_output_dtype -q --tb=short
.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run --files vllm/model_executor/determinism/batch_invariant.py tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py
.venv/bin/python -m pre_commit run mypy-3.12 --hook-stage manual --files vllm/model_executor/determinism/batch_invariant.py tests/v1/determinism/test_batch_invariance.py
git diff --check
```

## Test Result

macOS, Python 3.12.11, PyTorch 2.13.0; base `75fad5bbef7b2c0264c4b7ce6c4c10e32233d523`.

- Before: **4 failed, 8 passed, 12 skipped**. All failures were FP32-versus-FP16/BF16 output dtype mismatches.
- After: **12 passed, 12 skipped**. Eight unrelated tests were deselected in both runs.
- Applicable pre-commit hooks, targeted Python 3.12 mypy, and `git diff --check`: passed.

CPU cases replace only `mean_dim` with `torch.mean` to isolate the wrapper's dtype contract. CUDA cases use the real Triton reduction and skipped locally because no GPU is available. The isolated unit test uses the existing `skip_global_cleanup` marker because it creates no distributed state; this also avoids an unrelated macOS accelerator-cache teardown crash.

**GPU and model validation pending.** CUDA execution, GPU batch-invariance checks, and OCR model evaluation/serving have not run. No end-to-end success is claimed. The regression is in the existing Buildkite determinism suite and the test-tethering hook passed. The [contribution guide](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/75fad5bbef7b2c0264c4b7ce6c4c10e32233d523/docs/contributing/README.md#testing) permits GPU unit tests to run through CI when no GPU is available; OCR model evaluation is still outstanding.
title: [Bugfix][Determinism] Preserve output dtype in batch-invariant mean
